pages.title: The difference-mode multiplier
pages.text:
The diﬀerence-mode multiplier
dn+1 = (1 − 2kh)dn.
Decay requires 0 < kh < 1. Monotone decay requires 0 < kh ≤ 1/2. A conserved total
can coexist with an inaccurate or oscillating state.

pages.title: A local truncation calculation
pages.text:
A local truncation calculation
e−2kh = 1 − 2kh + 2k2h2 + O(h3).
Euler retains only the ﬁrst two terms. The one-step diﬀerence is O(h2) and the
accumulated ﬁxed-time error is O(h).

pages.title: Informative observation times
pages.text:
Informative observation times
The initial measurement carries no sensitivity to k when the initial state is ﬁxed. Late
measurements approach 5 mg for every positive k.
The magnitude te−2kt is largest at
t = 1/(2k).
